This plot of beans is small but important for feeding my family, so I will manage it carefully with what I have. I will plant with seed I saved from last season because improved seed is too expensive and hard to find at the agro-dealer. I will put manure on the soil since I keep some goats and can collect their droppings, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer because my money is needed for other things and beans do not need too much nitrogen. I will spray a little pesticide because the bean pod borer and aphids always come, and I cannot risk losing the crop to insects. The rains here in the North Central are enough for beans, so I will not irrigate. My children and I will do the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, but I may pay for a few days of extra hands when it is time to clear the land and bring in the harvest.
